definitions.short: a lying down (of dew, or for the sexual act)
definitions.full: H7902. shekabah [ שְׁכָבָה ] noun feminine act of lying, layer ; — only construct שִׁכְבַת all P; — 1 act of lying , as accusative of congnate meaning with verb with שׁכב 3: שִׁכְבַתזָֿ֑רַע Lev 15:18 a man lies with her a lying of seed (in copulation), compare 19:20 ; Num 5:13 ; then ( = semen ), שִׁכְבַתזָֿ֑רַע תֵּצֵא Lev 15:16 , 32 ; 22:4 (+ מִמֶּנּוּ ), ׳שׁ ׳ז alone 15:17 . 2 layer of dew, הַטָּ֑ל שִׁכְבַת Exod 16:13-14 , (P).
